purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-cicd-setup. S* queries must route here (pipeline install + documented pipeline symptoms); N* must NOT (code that passes the gate → clean-code, test tooling → test-lint-setup, auth symptoms in production → auth-setup).
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.method_note: Judges ran as subagents given the skill listing as TEXT (generated from the repo SKILL.md frontmatter) and instructed to answer only from it — the 2026-08-03 contamination, where judges named their own environment skills, did not recur: every answer came from the supplied listing.
baseline_result.note: S-side 24/24 including every pipeline-failure symptom. N-side 15/15: writing gate-passing code went to clean-code, vitest/junit setup to test-lint-setup, the prod-only login loop to auth-setup, and the prod-only 404 to pitfalls — the four neighbours this skill is most often confused with.
